2. Scope of Work Executed
Small Buildings works for Trishakti Power Generation Corporation completed 2020.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included hard rock encountered below the founding level
over part of the alignment. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the
department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path
intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of restricted working hours imposed near the
adjoining school. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no
compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved
drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all
respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.
DOC-CC-151

3. Quality Assessment
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Satisfactory. Workmanship was satisfactory after remedial
work on the first pour, and final inspection was completed in the presence of the client's representative.
Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with this office were within the limits
prescribed in the contract specification.

5. Deficiency / Observation List
At the time of taking over, no deficiency of consequence was recorded at handover. Regarding site safety, no
lost-time injury was reported over the contract period. The agency's conduct during the contract is recorded
as professional, though correspondence on variations was occasionally slow.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2020-06-03. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the
inspecting authority.
6. Recommendation
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint
measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of
the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified
by N. Sinha, Project Director.
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
undersigned.
